given: Own month absent; valid current generation and unused key; expectedVersion=null.
then: 201, version "1", Location, current generation, replay=false. Budget/version/success receipt commit together; acknowledgment follows commit.

given: Own month at version "7"; matching expectedVersion, currency and current generation; new key.
then: 200 version "8", current generation, replay=false; one atomic commit.

given: Same as update, but body values equal stored values.
then: 200 version "8"; an accepted replacement increments once even with unchanged values.

given: Own month already at version "1"; fresh key and current generation.
then: 409 BUDGET_VERSION_CONFLICT with complete current own Budget; no budget/version/success-receipt changes.

given: Own month at "9"; fresh key and current generation.
then: 409 BUDGET_VERSION_CONFLICT with version "9" snapshot; no budget/version/success-receipt changes; preserve draft for explicit review.

given: Own month absent; fresh key and current generation.
then: 409 BUDGET_VERSION_CONFLICT with currentBudget=null; no budget/version/success-receipt changes.

given: Existing RUB budget at "7"; expectedVersion="7" and fresh key; internally consistent USD body.
then: 400 INVALID_REQUEST; immutable currency checked after matching version; no budget/version/success-receipt changes.

given: Existing RUB budget at "9"; internally valid USD body with expectedVersion="8".
when: PUT under current generation and fresh key.
then: 409 BUDGET_VERSION_CONFLICT before immutable-currency refusal; no budget/version/success-receipt changes.

given: Budget at "9223372036854775807"; fresh key, matching version/currency/generation.
then: 409 BUDGET_VERSION_EXHAUSTED; no budget/version/success-receipt changes. GET remains available; preserve draft and require operator intervention, never reset version or suggest a new-key retry.

given: Budget at maximum revision; matching retained successful receipt.
then: Replay historical 200/201 status/body/creation Location with replay=true; no revision increment or exhaustion refusal.

given: Receipt retained for this exact verified owner, key and validated binding.
then: Return original committed status/body/creation Location, current generation, replay=true; no new write.

given: Retained receipt for a valid JSON body.
when: Retry with reordered objects, insignificant whitespace and equivalent escapes such as "\u0052UB" for "RUB".
then: Same structured binding and replay; duplicate decoded keys must be rejected first.

given: Retained exact key for this owner.
when: Change month, expectedVersion, amount, currency or null to zero while keeping a valid body/current generation.
then: 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; no mutation. Keys are scoped across months.

given: A retained receipt exists, but the request has an old well-formed generation.
then: 409 BUDGET_RECOVERY_REQUIRED with current generation, before owner creation, receipt lookup or mutation; never replay across generation mismatch.

given: Two verified owners use the same ASCII key/month/body and current generation.
when: Each owner creates its own budget.
then: Independent operations and receipts; never reveal another owner’s budget, key history or conflict snapshot.

given: A successful receipt belongs to verified (iss, sub); old access token expired.
when: Retry using a newly valid token with exactly the same verified owner and sufficient permissions.
then: Replay allowed; token bytes, expiry and jti are not binding data.

given: Browser retains a pending operation, then another user signs in.
then: Do not silently send as the new owner; preserve immutable operation identity and draft for explicit user review.

given: Two authenticated valid requests have the same owner/key/binding.
when: Original commits while waiter coordinates through database uniqueness.
then: Waiter replays the committed receipt; only one budget mutation.

given: Same duplicate requests; original transaction rolls back.
when: Waiter obtains the operation after rollback.
then: Waiter may perform normal fresh checks; no durable pending receipt and no invented success.

given: Original duplicate remains unresolved at the configurable coordination deadline, initially five seconds.
then: 409 SAVE_RESULT_UNAVAILABLE, saveOutcome=unknown, no second write. Original may still commit; five seconds is not an end-to-end SLA.

given: Receipt confirms version "8", while current Budget is version "9" and draft has newer edits.
then: Return historical version "8" success; confirm earlier operation, GET current state and retain newer draft edits.

given: Operation first sent at T0, committed at Tc; retries occur later.
when: Retry before T0+24h; retain receipt through at least Tc+24h.
then: Manual retry uses unchanged pending operation; neither retry nor token refresh resets first-send deadline.

given: At least 24h elapsed since first send; receipt may have been cleaned up.
then: Preserve draft, GET current state and require review/new operation/key. Receipt absence proves neither prior failure nor all historical changed-content reuse.

given: Distinct accepted ASCII keys produce the same SHA-256 index digest.
when: Compare retained original key before using receipt.
then: Fail closed with 500 INTERNAL_ERROR and no mutation; never treat a digest match alone as key equality.

given: Authenticated authorized PUT with missing, malformed or repeated generation.
when: Validate syntax before accessing current generation/owner/receipts.
then: 400 INVALID_REQUEST; no generation response header, no owner creation or mutation.

given: Service restarts or performs compatible application rollback.
then: Keep externally persisted generation and committed database state/receipts; do not initialize a new generation on each restart.

given: Budget database restored to an older snapshot.
when: Before reopening writes, fence old writers and install a fresh external generation.
then: Old-generation PUT refuses before owner/receipt/write even if version happens to match. Preserve drafts; GET and explicit review precede a new operation/key. Acknowledged writes/receipts within the RPO may be lost; generation does not restore them.

given: Authenticated owner has no budget for month; owner mapping may not yet exist.
then: 404 BUDGET_NOT_FOUND with month and current generation, no-store; create neither budget nor owner row.

given: Trusted Keycloak access JWT: exact issuer, verified nonempty sub, RS256, sole audience, principal_type=user, valid iat/exp and optional nbf.
when: GET with budget:read or PUT with budget:read and budget:write.
then: Owner is exact (iss, sub); no additional privileges from extra claims/scopes. Verify every request including replay before private-data access.

given: Missing/invalid/expired token, wrong issuer/audience/algorithm, missing subject, ID/refresh token, invalid iat/exp/nbf or lifetime over 300 seconds (30s clock tolerance for timestamps).
then: 401 AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED, correct Bearer challenge, no private-data access; profile/permission validation is not proved by OpenAPI.

given: Otherwise valid eligible user JWT lacks an operation’s required scopes.
then: 403 FORBIDDEN with insufficient_scope challenge listing budget:read for GET or budget:read budget:write for PUT; no private-data access.

given: Valid JWT has missing/non-user principal_type, including client-credentials identities, even with Budget scopes.
then: 403 FORBIDDEN; do not mislabel principal rejection as insufficient_scope. Email/client ID/azp never substitutes for the end-user subject.

given: Token verification needs an uncached trusted key and JWKS lookup is unavailable.
then: Fail closed with 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, not 401 invalid token. An acceptable cached verification key needs no live Keycloak call.

given: Future real realm/client configuration and token exchange V2.
when: Issue/exchange delegated user tokens and attempt privilege expansion through scope/audience/principal claims.
then: PENDING integration proof: sole audience, preserved subject, trusted account-derived principal_type, <=5 minute lifetime and effective scope downscoping; requesting scopes alone is not proof.

given: Missing/expired/invalid session or failed CSRF/origin check.
then: 401 AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED or 403 CSRF_REJECTED with web-owned type; no forwarding. Required session-store/token-exchange outage instead returns 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE and fails closed.

given: BFF receives unexpected delegated Go 401/403 or malformed upstream response.
then: 502 UPSTREAM_ERROR with web-owned type; forwarded PUT gets saveOutcome=unknown unless commit outcome is established. Never forward a Go authentication failure as a browser-session diagnosis.

given: PUT forwarded to Go; timeout prevents determining commit outcome.
then: 504 SAVE_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN with saveOutcome=unknown and no-store; no automatic retry or definite-save-failure message.

given: Valid documented Go success/problem response.
then: Preserve status/body/type/key-generation values, generation/replay/cache headers and applicable challenges; rewrite creation Location to /api/web/v1/budgets/{month}, including creation replay. If cross-origin configured, explicitly allow/expose relevant headers.

given: A forwarded PUT fails ambiguously, including internal or upstream failure.
then: Require saveOutcome=unknown unless commit outcome is established; the marker may be added when needed. Its absence on any current refusal never proves that an earlier attempt with this key failed.

given: Problem producer emits documented fields; a future compatible extension reaches a consumer.
then: Match stable code/type/status; tolerate unknown problem extensions and never machine-parse detail. UI conflict review applies only to BUDGET_VERSION_CONFLICT.

given: HTTP parser has removed framing outer OWS; parsed key/generation has legal grammar.
when: Validate logical field value and compare operation identity.
then: Accept all grammar-valid values, including non-UUID values; names case-insensitive, values case-sensitive. Do not trim further or claim detection of framing whitespace already removed.
